body: Crash-dialog recovery verified: on next crash (PID25320), Escape timed out and accessibility returned null. Explicit sky.activate_window on the CSRSS dialog succeeded; Alt+N then dismissed it, and fresh window/process checks confirmed game exit. No upload. User requested trying this on subsequent crashes; reuse focus then Alt+N. Runtime trace reached after_first_tick and before_raycast, no measurement file. The ray stage is now a separate explicit probe with markers after native ray and readiness query; visual-only rendering no longer invokes it. Rebuilt/deployed and launched PID14300. Run resumed; prior manual-dismissal blocker is resolved.
